standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of the pullback functor f^{-1} on abelian sheaves
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Sites, section on morphisms of topoi (exactness of f^{-1})
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies transporting surjectivity from f_*a to f^{-1}f_*a.

core_obligations: Assume (1) and let a : F -> F' be a map whose pushforward is surjective; use exactness of f^{-1} to make f^{-1}f_*a surjective and then (1) to conclude that a is surjective, giving (2) (proof lines 1689-1697).
Assume (2) and reduce the surjectivity of f^{-1}f_*F -> F to surjectivity of f_* applied to it, which holds by the existence of the canonical comparison map (proof lines 1699-1706).
Conclude that f_* is faithful in that case, completing the proof up to line 1706.
proof_roadmap: Transport surjectivity along the exact functor f^{-1}.
Use the canonical comparison to reverse the implication.
Record faithfulness as the concluding statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes morphisms of topoi whose pushforward on abelian sheaves reflects surjections by the surjectivity of the canonical maps f^{-1}f_*F -> F, and shows that in that case the pushforward is faithful. The forward implication uses exactness of f^{-1} to transport surjectivity of f_*a to f^{-1}f_*a and then the hypothesis to conclude that a is surjective; the converse reduces the surjectivity of f^{-1}f_*F -> F to a statement about f_* applied to it, using a canonical comparison map (proof lines 1688-1706). H2: the two reductions through exactness of f^{-1} and the canonical comparison are the substance.
